title: 사립학교보조와원조에관한건 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Subsidies and Decisions)
(1) Each year, the Minister of Education shall notify educational foundations eligible for subsidies of the subsidies planned for them and require them to submit applications for subsidies. <Amended on March 16, 1991; January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; March 23, 2013>
(2) The Minister of Education shall decide whether to grant subsidies on the applications submitted by educational foundations under paragraph (1) and notify the relevant educational foundations of the decisions. <Amended on March 16, 1991; January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; March 23, 2013>
